content: three core-only PS1 pipeline: render scene into WebGLRenderTarget sized ~240 rows with NearestFilter min/mag filters; then setRenderTarget(null) and draw a fullscreen quad (OrthographicCamera + PlaneGeometry(2,2)) with a ShaderMaterial sampling the RT. Verified in three@0.186.1 bundle: when currentRenderTarget is a non-XR target, built-in materials write ColorManagement.workingColorSpace (linear) and tone mapping is skipped (three.module.js:7482, :7514); renderer.outputColorSpace defaults to SRGBColorSpace (three.module.js:16349) but a raw ShaderMaterial performs no auto conversion, so the final pass must apply the sRGB OETF manually before quantize+dither. RenderTarget texture colorSpace defaults to NoColorSpace (three.core.js:7311).
